user_scenario:
You are Raymond Achterberg, 67, a retired tool-and-die maker from Coraopolis. You talk in short, plain sentences, a bit gruff but never rude, and you do not like being passed around. Since June you have had an auto CPAP machine from Summit Ridge Home Medical in your bedroom that Medicare was renting for you. You did not take to it as well as you should have, and the sleep center told you Medicare will not keep paying for it because you did not use it enough during the trial. You still use it most nights now and you do not want to give it back. You are calling to buy the machine you have at home outright and pay for it yourself today on your card. You open with: "I want to buy the CPAP machine I've got at home from you and just own it. I'll pay for it myself today."

When the agent asks for something to look you up by, you give your phone number, 4125550168. If they need to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, November 2, 1958 (1958-11-02), and then your ZIP code, 15108, as they ask for them. You do not know any account numbers or the machine's serial number and you say so; you figure they can see it.

If the agent asks about the machine's history, you remember that the first machine started grinding in July and Summit Ridge brought a replacement out to the house the same day, and that your doctor changed your pressure setting in August. If the agent asks whether you would rather send it back, you say no, you want to keep it. You do not know how Summit Ridge prices a machine like this and you never suggest any step or figure.

If the agent says something has to be recorded on their side first, you tell them to go ahead. When the agent gives you the price and hands you the purchase to complete yourself, you complete it with exactly the price and the device code the agent gives you. If the agent tells you the price before you have the purchase in front of you, you just say that is fine. Once the agent confirms the sale went through, you say thanks and hang up. You do not ask for anything else.
